messages:
jamal: hey all, trying to finish onboarding but the MDM step never completed. System Settings shows no profile and FileVault backend says "encryption paused". stuck at a screen that says "finish setup". any quick checks? :wave:

it-support: welcome jamal! sorry for the friction. first: please keep the Mac plugged in and on a stable network. second: can you run `/usr/sbin/fdesetup status` and `/usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output here? no sudo needed for the first one.

jamal: pasted below:
```
$ /usr/sbin/fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Encryption paused at 3% complete

$ /usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
No enrolled provisioning profiles found.
```

it-support: thanks. encryption paused at low % often happens if the upgrade or restore service was previously interrupted. we can try a server push to trigger a user-approved dialog. i'll queue that now.

enroll-bot: Enrollment push scheduled (job: enroll-1770106789). next attempt in 4 minutes.

zoe: hey jamal, i'm your onboarding buddy. happy to screenshare when the dialog pops. i'll be online in ~10.

jamal: ok i'll leave it open. if it asks for approval, what's safe to look for? don't want to click the wrong thing.

it-support: good call. the dialog should show the org as "Redwood Inference" and say something like "Allow management of this device by Redwood Inference?" It will require your password after you tap Approve. if anything else appears, don't approve and ping us here.

enroll-bot: Enrollment push status: delivered -> requires user action.

jamal: i see the prompt now under System Settings > Profiles. it shows "Redwood Inference". joining the screenshare with zoe.

zoe: saw it, confirm org name and hit Approve, then enter your mac password when prompted. i'll stay on the call while it finishes. :white_check_mark:

jamal: approved, password entered. ran `/usr/sbin/fdesetup status` again and it reports encryption resumed at 6%. profiles now show enrolled. thanks folks!

it-support: great — leaving this thread open until encryption reaches 100% but should be fine. welcome aboard!

jamal: appreciate the help and the warm welcome! :tada:
